body: [opus 5.5] Delivered by #233 llm-summarizer: thread display_name (slug chosen once) and a one-sentence summary from one Messages API call to Haiku, refreshed at 1, 2, 4, 8 then every 10 messages; deployed on devbig014 with the playground gateway overlay. Unverified: no live call observed yet (calls start when the Threads screen or the two-column thread list is read). Closing; a failure on first use is a new issue.
